name: Bulbasaur
description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

name: Venusaur
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Charmander
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle
description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
description: This Pokémon is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

name: Blastoise
description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Caterpie
description: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: Metapod
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
description: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this Pokémon can fly about even in rain.

name: Weedle
description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
description: This Pokémon is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

name: Beedrill
description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Pidgey
description: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

name: Pidgeotto
description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Rattata
description: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
description: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

name: Spearow
description: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses Mirror Move.

name: Fearow
description: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.

name: Ekans
description: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

name: Arbok
description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Pikachu
description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Raichu
description: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: Sandshrew
description: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

name: Sandslash
description: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

name: Nidoran
description: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

name: Nidoqueen
description: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

name: Nidoran
description: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
description: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

name: Nidoking
description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

name: Clefairy
description: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

name: Clefable
description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Vulpix
description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
description: It has nine long tails and fur that  gleams gold. It is said to live for  1,000 years.

name: Jigglypuff
description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

name: Zubat
description: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

name: Golbat
description: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

name: Oddish
description: Its scientific name is Oddium Wanderus. At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

name: Gloom
description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
description: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.

name: Paras
description: Growing out of the bug's back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

name: Parasect
description: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

name: Venonat
description: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

name: Venomoth
description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Diglett
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Meowth
description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
description: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Psyduck
description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

name: Mankey
description: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

name: Primeape
description: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

name: Growlithe
description: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Arcanine
description: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

name: Poliwag
description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Poliwrath
description: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: Abra
description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

name: Kadabra
description: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into Kadabra.

name: Alakazam
description: It does not like physical attacks very  much. Instead, it freely uses extra- sensory powers to defeat foes.

name: Machop
description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
description: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Bellsprout
description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
description: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

name: Tentacool
description: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

name: Tentacruel
description: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

name: Geodude
description: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

name: Graveler
description: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. Graveler may come rolling down the path without slowing.

name: Golem
description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

name: Ponyta
description: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Rapidash
description: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

name: Slowpoke
description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Slowbro
description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Magnemite
description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
description: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: Farfetch'd
description: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

name: Doduo
description: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
description: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
description: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

name: Grimer
description: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.

name: Muk
description: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

name: Shellder
description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

name: Gastly
description: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: Haunter
description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Gengar
description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

name: Onix
description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Drowzee
description: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

name: Hypno
description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took  away a child it hypnotized.

name: Krabby
description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler
description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Voltorb
description: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly SelfDestruct.

name: Electrode
description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of The Bomb Ball.

name: Exeggcute
description: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.

name: Exeggutor
description: It is called The Walking Tropical Rainforest. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

name: Cubone
description: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.

name: Marowak
description: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

name: Hitmonlee
description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Lickitung
description: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

name: Koffing
description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhydon
description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Chansey
description: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

name: Tangela
description: Blue plant vines cloak the Pokémon's identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

name: Kangaskhan
description: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using Comet Punch.

name: Horsea
description: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

name: Seadra
description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

name: Goldeen
description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
description: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

name: Staryu
description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Starmie
description: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: Mr. Mime
description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

name: Scyther
description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

name: Jynx
description: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

name: Electabuzz
description: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Magmar
description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Pinsir
description: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won't release until the foe is torn.

name: Tauros
description: When it is about to Tackle, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

name: Magikarp
description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

name: Ditto
description: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.

name: Eevee
description: An extremely rare Pokémon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

name: Vaporeon
description: Its body's cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

name: Jolteon
description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Flareon
description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
description: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.

name: Omanyte
description: A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

name: Omastar
description: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.

name: Kabuto
description: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

name: Kabutops
description: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim's fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
description: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

name: Snorlax
description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Articuno
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.

name: Zapdos
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

name: Moltres
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.

name: Dratini
description: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

name: Dragonair
description: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

name: Dragonite
description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Mewtwo
description: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

name: Mew
description: A Pokémon of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

name: Chikorita
description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

name: Bayleef
description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Meganium
description: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Cyndaquil
description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: Quilava
description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Typhlosion
description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Totodile
description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
description: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

name: Feraligatr
description: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

name: Sentret
description: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Furret
description: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting Rattata.

name: Hoothoot
description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Ledyba
description: When the weather turns cold, numerous Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

name: Ledian
description: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

name: Spinarak
description: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

name: Ariados
description: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

name: Crobat
description: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

name: Pichu
description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Cleffa
description: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely increase.

name: Igglybuff
description: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

name: Togepi
description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Togetic
description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Natu
description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

name: Xatu
description: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

name: Mareep
description: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
description: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

name: Ampharos
description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

name: Bellossom
description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Marill
description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

name: Azumarill
description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

name: Sudowoodo
description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Politoed
description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Hoppip
description: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

name: Skiploom
description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
description: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world  to make more offspring.

name: Aipom
description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Sunkern
description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Sunflora
description: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

name: Yanma
description: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

name: Wooper
description: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Quagsire
description: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Espeon
description: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

name: Umbreon
description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

name: Murkrow
description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Slowking
description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Misdreavus
description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Unown
description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wobbuffet
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Girafarig
description: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

name: Pineco
description: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

name: Forretress
description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Dunsparce
description: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

name: Gligar
description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Steelix
description: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Snubbull
description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Granbull
description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its Bite is powerful.

name: Qwilfish
description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Scizor
description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Shuckle
description: It stores Berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Heracross
description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

name: Sneasel
description: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

name: Teddiursa
description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
description: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Slugma
description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Swinub
description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

name: Piloswine
description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Corsola
description: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.

name: Remoraid
description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

name: Octillery
description: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow Octillery.

name: Delibird
description: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

name: Mantine
description: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

name: Skarmory
description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Houndour
description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Houndoom
description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Kingdra
description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Phanpy
description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: Donphan
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

name: Porygon2
description: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

name: Stantler
description: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

name: Smeargle
description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Tyrogue
description: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Hitmontop
description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Smoochum
description: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

name: Elekid
description: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

name: Magby
description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Miltank
description: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: Blissey
description: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

name: Raikou
description: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Entei
description: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Suicune
description: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Larvitar
description: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

name: Pupitar
description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Tyranitar
description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Lugia
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Ho-Oh
description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Celebi
description: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.
Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.
It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.
It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.
It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.
Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.
Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.
It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.
If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging Pidgey.
They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.
A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.
It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Treecko
description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Grovyle
description: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Sceptile
description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

name: Torchic
description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Combusken
description: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Blaziken
description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Mudkip
description: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Marshtomp
description: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Swampert
description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Poochyena
description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

name: Mightyena
description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

name: Zigzagoon
description: It is always hungry because it won't stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't keep still.

name: Linoone
description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Wurmple
description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Silcoon
description: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Beautifly
description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Cascoon
description: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Dustox
description: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

name: Lotad
description: It emits a variety of sounds from the  holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

name: Lombre
description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Ludicolo
description: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Seedot
description: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

name: Nuzleaf
description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

name: Shiftry
description: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

name: Nincada
description: The favorite of trend-conscious female Trainers, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

name: Ninjask
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Shedinja
description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Taillow
description: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

name: Swellow
description: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: Shroomish
description: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

name: Breloom
description: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

name: Spinda
description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Wingull
description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Pelipper
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Surskit
description: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

name: Masquerain
description: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Wailmer
description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Wailord
description: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

name: Skitty
description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Delcatty
description: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

name: Kecleon
description: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

name: Baltoy
description: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

name: Claydol
description: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

name: Nosepass
description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Torkoal
description: It is among the largest of all Pokémon. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

name: Sableye
description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Barboach
description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Whiscash
description: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

name: Luvdisc
description: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Corphish
description: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

name: Crawdaunt
description: No two Spinda are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

name: Feebas
description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: Milotic
description: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

name: Carvanha
description: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

name: Sharpedo
description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Trapinch
description: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

name: Vibrava
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Flygon
description: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is Altaria's humming.

name: Makuhita
description: If it comes across a Seviper, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

name: Hariyama
description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Electrike
description: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.

name: Manectric
description: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

name: Numel
description: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

name: Camerupt
description: It makes its nest at the bottom of  swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Spheal
description: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

name: Sealeo
description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Walrein
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Cacnea
description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Cacturne
description: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

name: Snorunt
description: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

name: Glalie
description: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

name: Lunatone
description: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

name: Solrock
description: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

name: Azurill
description: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

name: Spoink
description: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud,  depending on the weather.

name: Grumpig
description: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

name: Plusle
description: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Minun
description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

name: Mawile
description: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: Meditite
description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Medicham
description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Swablu
description: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.

name: Altaria
description: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

name: Wynaut
description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Duskull
description: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dusclops
description: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Roselia
description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

name: Slakoth
description: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning Spheal on its nose.

name: Vigoroth
description: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

name: Slaking
description: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

name: Gulpin
description: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

name: Swalot
description: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

name: Tropius
description: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

name: Whismur
description: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

name: Loudred
description: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

name: Exploud
description: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

name: Clamperl
description: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: Huntail
description: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

name: Gorebyss
description: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won't leave a scratch.

name: Absol
description: It is formed by two Metang fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

name: Shuppet
description: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

name: Banette
description: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

name: Seviper
description: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

name: Zangoose
description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Relicanth
description: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

name: Aron
description: This Pokémon is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

name: Lairon
description: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Aggron
description: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

name: Castform
description: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

name: Volbeat
description: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

name: Illumise
description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Lileep
description: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

name: Cradily
description: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

name: Anorith
description: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Armaldo
description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

name: Ralts
description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Kirlia
description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Gardevoir
description: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Bagon
description: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

name: Shelgon
description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Salamence
description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Beldum
description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

name: Metang
description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Metagross
description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Regirock
description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Regice
description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

name: Registeel
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Kyogre
description: It rests its forelegs on others to communicate with rhythmic electric pulses from its claws.

name: Groudon
description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Rayquaza
description: It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.

name: Latias
description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

name: Latios
description: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

name: Jirachi
description: Its powerful headbutt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

name: Deoxys
description: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

name: Chimecho
description: When attacked, they form a wall with their shield like faces to protect their young.

name: Bad Egg
description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: UNOWNB
description: It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

name: UNOWNC
description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: UNOWND
description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.

name: UNOWNE
description: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

name: UNOWNF
description: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: UNOWNG
description: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: UNOWNH
description: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

name: UNOWNI
description: The small ball is not only full of nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: UNOWNJ
description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

name: UNOWNK
description: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

name: UNOWNL
description: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

name: UNOWNM
description: It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.

name: UNOWNN
description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: UNOWNO
description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: UNOWNP
description: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: UNOWNQ
description: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

name: UNOWNR
description: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.

name: UNOWNS
description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.

name: UNOWNT
description: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

name: UNOWNU
description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: UNOWNV
description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

name: UNOWNW
description: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.

name: UNOWNX
description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

name: UNOWNY
description: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.

name: UNOWNZ
description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: UNOWN!
description: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body's fluid levels.

name: UNOWN?
description: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

name: Turtwig
description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.

name: Grotle
description: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: Torterra
description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone.

name: Chimchar
description: It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold, it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.

name: Monferno
description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot into its nest.

name: Infernape
description: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Piplup
description: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

name: Prinplup
description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Empoleon
description: It has the ability to sense the Auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Starly
description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

name: Staravia
description: Surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of strength.

name: Staraptor
description: It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.

name: Bidoof
description: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.

name: Bibarel
description: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

name: Kricketot
description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Kricketune
description: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.

name: Shinx
description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Luxio
description: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

name: Luxray
description: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.

name: Budew
description: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

name: Roserade
description: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as 'The Ice Monster.'.

name: Cranidos
description: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost-covered trees and ice.

name: Rampardos
description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Shieldon
description: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

name: Bastiodon
description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Burmy
description: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Wormadam
description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Mothim
description: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

name: Combee
description: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

name: Vespiquen
description: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

name: Pachirisu
description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

name: Buizel
description: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.

name: Floatzel
description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Cherubi
description: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

name: Cherrim
description: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

name: Shellos
description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

name: Gastrodon
description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Ambipom
description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Drifloon
description: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.

name: Drifblim
description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Buneary
description: Known as 'The Being of Knowledge.' It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Lopunny
description: Known as 'The Being of Emotion.' It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Mismagius
description: Known as 'The Being of Willpower.' It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

name: Honchkrow
description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

name: Glameow
description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Purugly
description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Chingling
description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Stunky
description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Skuntank
description: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

name: Bronzor
description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Bronzong
description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Bonsly
description: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

name: Mime Jr.
description: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Happiny
description: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Chatot
description: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Spiritomb
description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Gible
description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Gabite
description: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it.

name: Garchomp
description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Munchlax
description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Riolu
description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Lucario
description: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle--it is also used to break open hard berries.

name: Hippopotas
description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Hippowdon
description: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

name: Skorupi
description: Extremely cautious, one of them is always on a lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Drapion
description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Croagunk
description: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

name: Toxicroak
description: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

name: Carnivine
description: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

name: Finneon
description: They trick people with cuteness, and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

name: Lumineon
description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Mantyke
description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Snover
description: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.

name: Abomasnow
description: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Weavile
description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Magnezone
description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants using its tail.

name: Lickilicky
description: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Rhyperior
description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Tangrowth
description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Electivire

name: Magmortar
description: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

name: Togekiss
description: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

name: Yanmega
description: Its mane shines when discharging electricity. It uses flashing manes to communicate with others.

name: Leafeon
description: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Glaceon
description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Gliscor
description: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It's about to fire off bursts of energy.

name: Mamoswine
description: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

name: Porygon-Z
description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Gallade

name: Probopass
description: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Dusknoir
description: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can cut through a steel plate, no matter the thickness.

name: Froslass
description: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Rotom
description: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

name: Uxie
description: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

name: Mesprit

name: Azelf
description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Dialga
description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Palkia
description: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

name: Heatran
description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Regigigas
description: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Giratina

name: Cresselia
description: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.

name: Phione
description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves.

name: Manaphy
description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Darkrai
description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Shaymin
description: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

name: Arceus
description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body to serve as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Victini
description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Snivy
description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: Servine
description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Dewott

name: Samurott

name: Patrat

name: Watchog

name: Yamask

name: Cofagrigus

name: Tirtouga

name: Archeops
description: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

description: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Garbodor

name: Zorua
description: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Zoroark

name: Minccino

name: Ducklett

name: Vanillite
description: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Vanilluxe

name: Sawsbuck
description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Emolga
description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

name: Karrablast
description: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.

name: Escavalier

name: Foongus

name: Amoonguss
description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Frillish
description: Lands visited by Landorus grant bountiful crops. It has been hailed as 'The Guardian of the Fields.'.

name: Jellicent
description: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

name: Alomomola
description: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Joltik
description: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

name: Galvantula
description: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Ferroseed
description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

name: Ferrothorn
description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Klink
description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Klang
description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to very hot air.

name: Klinklang
description: With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on its tail on fire and launches into battle.

name: Tynamo
description: It gazes into the flame at its branch to achieve a focused state, allowing it to see the future.

name: Eelektrik
description: It secretes bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would take when attacked.

name: Eelektross
description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Elgyem
description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water, that can split metal in two.

name: Beheeyem
description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

description: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble.

name: Lampent

name: Chandelure

name: Fraxure

name: Haxorus
description: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Cubchoo
description: The colorful patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat.

name: Beartic
description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat and power flow through its body.

name: Cryogonal
description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Shelmet
description: It draws and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower it holds is most likely part of its body.

description: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Mienshao

name: Druddigon
description: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

description: This Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Rufflet
description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an accomplished opponent.

name: Braviary
description: It can detect the innate qualities of leadership. Whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

description: It emits a scent that delights those who smell it. The fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

description: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.

description: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles.

description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do anything.

name: Larvesta

name: Cobalion
description: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Terrakion
description: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

description: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Tornadus
description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

description: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force to chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

name: Zekrom
description: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: Landorus
description: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

name: Kyurem
description: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around -240 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Keldeo
description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Meloetta

name: Genesect

description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

description: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

description: Although basically cool and cautious, when it's caught by surprise, it's seized by panic.

description: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

description: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.

description: It prefers to eat fresh living things so it marches down streets in search of prey.
