description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Landorus
description: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!

name: Keldeo
description: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. It weakens enemies and sends them reeling with it.

name: Chespin
description: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.

name: Quilladin
description: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.

name: Chesnaught
description: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in Alola region.

name: Fennekin
description: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it.

name: Braixen
description: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. It's quite painful when it smacks you!

name: Delphox
description: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

name: Froakie
description: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect so it is a hit to many people.

name: Frogadier
description: Known for its extreme intelligence, it will look down on inexperienced Trainers.

name: Greninja
description: They form groups of 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable-they will never let down a comrade.

name: Bunnelby
description: An astonishingly coward Pokémon, it whirs its legs at high speed to run away if anything comes near it.

name: Diggersby
description: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater-or even air-right in two.

name: Fletchling
description: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Fletchindr
description: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

name: Talonflame
description: Its body is covered with slime. If you accidentally step on it, you'll slip, and it will get mad at you!

name: Scatterbug
description: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.

name: Spewpa
description: It destroyed its own control mask. It has become capable of changing type by equipping special memories.

name: Vivillon
description: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

name: Litleo
description: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

name: Pyroar
description: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance.

name: Flabébé
description: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Floette
description: It conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and Pokémon.

name: Florges
description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off spikes. With its robust teeth, it crunches up and eats the spikes.

name: Skiddo
description: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger.

name: Gogoat
description: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey.

name: Pancham
description: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. It grows as it battles others.

name: Pangoro
description: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Furfrou
description: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.

name: Espurr
description: This guardian deity of Melemele summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: Meowstic
description: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. Its flowers' fragrant aroma is its source of energy.

name: Honedge
description: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes.

name: Doublade
description: The guardian deity of Poni can control water. It can create pure water that will wash away any impurity.

name: Aegislash
description: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Spritzee
description: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Aromatisse
description: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name 'the beast that devours the sun.'.

name: Swirlix
description: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

name: Slurpuff
description: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Inkay
description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Malamar
description: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Binacle
description: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Barbaracle
description: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Skrelp
description: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Dragalge
description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry-it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Clauncher
description: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it.

name: Clawitzer
description: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

name: Helioptile
description: It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. It is craven and cowering.

name: Heliolisk
description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Tyrunt
description: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid in its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Tyrantrum
description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form.

name: Amaura
description: It causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Aurorus
description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Sylveon
description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its molten steel body.

name: Hawlucha
description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, it has come back to life after 3000 years.

name: Dedenne
description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Carbink
description: The faster a Thwackey beats out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Goomy
description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Sliggoo
description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Its pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Goodra
description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Klefki
description: It gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Phantump
description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Trevenant
description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: It picks out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips.

name: Gourgeist
description: This Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Bergmite
description: This Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Avalugg
description: It will bravely challenge any foe, no matter how powerful. Even suffering a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Noibat
description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

name: Noivern
description: The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Xerneas
description: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Yveltal
description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor its surroundings and wait for evolution.

name: Zygarde
description: It's famous for its high intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it has immense psychic power.

name: Diancie
description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of others. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Hoopa
description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. It secretly marks its future targets.

name: Hoopa
description: It anchors itself in the ground and basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, it blooms vividly.

name: Volcanion
description: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that others can benefit.

name: Pyroar
description: If its fleece grows too long, it won't be able to move. Cloth made with its wool is surprisingly durable.

name: Meowstic
description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Aegislash
description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Arceus
description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Varoom
description: This greedy Pokémon only helps people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Revavroom
description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Zygarde
description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Zygarde
description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can easily travel at over 18 mph. It forms coal inside its body.

name: Greninja
description: While engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, scorching the surrounding area with sparks.

name: Tinkatink
description: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. the flavor of the apple is what determines its evolution.

name: Tinkatuff
description: It ate a sour apple, which induced its evolution. It stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns in its cheeks.

name: Tinkaton
description: It ate a sweet apple, which induced its evolution. Back in the day, children used to have it as a snack.

name: Pawmi
description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Pawmo
description: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. It becomes disheartened if it runs out.

name: Pawmot
description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow other Pokémon.

name: Lechonk
description: It becomes extremely sluggish after eating its fill. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Oinkologne
description: Its jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. It spins its tail fins to surge forward at over 100 knots.

name: Floette
description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. Despite a weak voltage, it can cause paralysis.

name: Oinkologne
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Gimmighoul
description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. It then coils around its prey and cooks it.

name: Gimmighoul
description: This excessively hostile Pokémon has large and very sharp fangs in addition to its dangerous burning body.

name: Gholdengo
description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Gourgeist
description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. It prefers areas without people.

name: Gourgeist
description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Gourgeist
description: Known as the Forest Witch, if you are too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle.

name: Greavard
description: It sneaks into people's homes, taking and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Houndstone
description: With sly cunning, it lures people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Tadbulb
description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to foes, ensnaring them like tentacles.

name: Bellibolt
description: It evolved after experiencing many fights. While crossing its arms, its shouts would make anyone flinch.

name: Finizen
description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Palafin
description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Palafin
description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk.

name: Noibat
description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Noivern
description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Farigiraf
description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Venusaur
description: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Strawberry Sweet. Its flavor depends on how it was mixed.

name: Charizard
description: The six of them work together as one. Teamwork is their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation.

name: Charizard
description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Blastoise
description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger its spikes grow.

name: Beedrill
description: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains.

name: Pidgeot
description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Alakazam
description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to stay cold.

name: Slowbro
description: Using its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Males will act as valets for those they serve.

name: Gengar
description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pouches, it generates electricity while satisfying its constant hunger.

name: Kangaskhan
description: If a job requires serious strength, Cufant will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning green.

name: Pinsir
description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks.

name: Gyarados
description: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Aerodactyl
description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Mewtwo
description: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but it can't breathe unless it's underwater.

name: Mewtwo
description: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made it go extinct anyway.

name: Ampharos
description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. However, its body rusts easily.

name: Steelix
description: After being reborn as a ghost, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Scizor
description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they evolve.

name: Heracross
description: Apparently the Dreepy inside its horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Houndoom
description: It  has slumbered for many years. Some say it is Zamazenta's elder sister, others say the two are rivals.

name: Tyranitar
description: It slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Sceptile
description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. The energy that its core absorbs allows it to live.

name: Blaziken
description: If it pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from deep in its belly.

name: Swampert
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, it races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Gardevoir
description: Once the vines on its body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Sableye
description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electric energy. Removing the rings on its body will unleash its latent power.

name: Mawile
description: A theory proposes that its arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon, although it remains unproven.

name: Aggron
description: It emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon - Anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Medicham
description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses except sight. Its kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Manectric
description: Its every move is filled with grace and dignity. Extremely intelligent, it is said to see past, present, and future events.

name: Sharpedo
description: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is currently under investigation. No information is available at this time.

name: Camerupt
description: A violent creature that fells tall trees wit its crude axes. One would be unlucky to chance upon this in the wilds.

name: Altaria
description: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is currently under investigation. No information is available at this time.

name: Banette
description: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is currently under investigation. No information is available at this time.

name: Absol
description: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is currently under investigation. No information is available at this time.

name: Glalie
description: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is currently under investigation. No information is available at this time.

name: Salamence
description: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is currently under investigation. No information is available at this time.

name: Metagross
description: Its fluffy fur is similar to plants. It frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Latias
description: It deftly wields the vine hidden under its long fur, slamming the flower bud against its foes.

name: Latios
description: It uses the reflective fur to camou- flage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that it's floating.

name: Groudon
description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbsed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Kyogre
description: Both its energy and vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on its head.

name: Rayquaza
description: The fiery bird changes shape when it sings. Rumor has it the bird was born when the fireball gained a soul.

name: Lopunny
description: It migrated to Paldea from far long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers re- pels water and grime.

name: Garchomp
description: It constantly runs through shallow waters to train their legs. Then, they compete with each other.

name: Lucario
description: A single kick from it can send a truck roll- ing. It uses its powerful legs to perform dances from far-off lands.

name: Abomasnow
description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Gallade
description: It is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emites a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Audino
description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, its natural enemy.

name: Diancie
description: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Dialga
description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, it jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Palkia
description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode.

name: Sprigatito
description: The pads of its paws discharge electricity. It shocks with its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Floragato
description: It uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity simultaneously.

name: Meowscrada
description: It is slow to react, but once it enters battle it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Fuecoco
description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find in exact- ly half then and eat it together.

name: Crocalor
description: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family, but nobody knows for sure.

name: Skeledirge
description: It is smooth and moist to touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Quaxly
description: The surface of its skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Quaxwell
description: It converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a week without eating.

name: Quaquaval
description: It shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has co-existed with humans since times long gone.

name: Wooper
description: It drives back enemies by lauunching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Clodsire
description: They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

name: Wiglett
description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. They were treasured since they would share precious salt.

name: Wugtrio
description: It dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

name: Ceruledge
description: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Armarouge
description: Its firepowerful increases when it fights, reaching over 1800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Kingambit
description: It clads itself in armor that's been fortified by psychic and fire energy. It shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Annihilape
description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the resentment of a sword wielder who fell before fulfillment.

name: Charcadet
description: It shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it makes its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Rowlet
description: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by its belly-button dynamo.

name: Dartrix
description: They make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling tex- ture, and they're a popular delicacy.

name: Decidueye
description: It inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, it can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Litten
description: Its well-developed jaw is strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Torracat
description: Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Incineroar
description: Though usually mellow, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Popplio
description: They paint its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Brionne
description: A soul unable to move on to the after- life until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Primarina
description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs what it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Pikipek
description: It lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and delicious.

name: Trumbeak
description: It gathers in groups and forms colonies deep within forests. They hate it when strangers approach.

name: Toucannon
description: They live on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps the foe's attack, then lunges for their  weak spots with its claws.

name: Yungoos
description: The more sunlight it bathes in, the spicier the chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Gumshoos
description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Grubbin
description: It rolls its mud ball around while the en- ergy it needs to evolve matures. Even- tually the time for it comes.

name: Charjabug
description: An infant sleeps inside the ball. It rolls the ball soothingly to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Vikavolt
description: It spends its time running around waste- lands. If anyone steals its berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Crabrawler
description: It emits psychic power from the gaps be- tween its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Crabminble
description: It pounds iron scraps to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Oricorio
description: It will attack groups of Pawniard, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Cutiefly
description: It's very intelligent and daring. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Ribombee
description: It can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Rockruff
description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey.

name: Lycanroc
description: It uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest.

name: Wishiwashi
description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that it secretes from its blowhole.

name: Mareanie
description: It changes appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. It will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Toxapex
description: It is said that it was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap factory.

name: Mudbray
description: It viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its mouth and sprays toxic.

name: Mudsdale
description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts its spirit.

name: Dewpider
description: It lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Araquanid
description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Fomantis
description: When it detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Lurantis
description: It doesn't like being alone. Pay it the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Morelull
description: A lovingly mounred Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like being touched on top of its head.

name: Shiinotic
description: It ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Salandit
description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Salazzle
description: It wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with strong muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

name: Stufful
description: It has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility.

name: Bewear
description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and fol- lows it loyally. Though powerful, it is apparently not very smart.

name: Bounsweet
description: It is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Steenee
description: When its anger rose beyond a certain point, it gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Tsareena
description: When attacked, it retaliates by sticking thick spines out of its body. It's risky and puts everything on the line.

name: Comfey
description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of it is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Oranguru
description: It will gently put Pokémon that wander into its nest onto its back and carry them to the entrance.

name: Passimian
description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Wimpod
description: It resembles a mysterious creature that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Golisopod
description: It resembles a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago. Its true origin is unknown.

name: Sandygast
description: It's described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Palossand
description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur covered in a magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Pyukumuku
description: It somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Type Null
description: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years. Data is lacking for it.

name: Silvally
description: Sightings of this occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Minior
description: It's similar to a robot that's said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

name: Komala
description: It shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Turtonator
description: It's described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: Togedemaru
description: It resembles an unknown object described in a dubious magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

name: Mimikyu
description: It has similarities to the Pokémon Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: Bruxish
description: It lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a fridge.

name: Drampa
description: It freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Dhelmise
description: It blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid- hot lava.

name: Jangmo-o
description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. It can get left in shop corners since no one realizes it's a Pokémon.

name: Hakamo-o
description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. It overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them.

name: Kommo-o
description: The grudge of a person punished for writing a king's evil deeds clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

name: Tapu Koko
description: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Tapu Lele
description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

name: Tapu Bulu
description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked many conflicts has clad itself in fire and became a Pokémon.

name: Tapu Fini
description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, it has a connection to a phenomenon that occurs in Kalos.

name: Cosmog
description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Cosmoem
description: It resembles Cyclizar, but is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Solgaleo
description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Lunala
description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster in an old journal.

name: Nihilego
description: According to few eyewitness accounts, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Buzzwole
description: It's two creatures in one. Its evo- lution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: Pheromosa
description: The regrets of a tea ceremony master died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became this.

name: Xurkitree
description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life force.

name: Celesteela
description: It's a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Kartana
description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulates its brain and causes its psychic powers to bloom.

name: Guzzlord
description: It beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Necrozma
description: Its type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Magearna
description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.

name: Marshadow
description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

name: Rattata
description: There are few sightings of this creature. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

name: Raticate
description: It incinerates everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

name: Raichu
description: It resembles a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Sandshrew
description: There was an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces.

name: Sandslash
description: It's thought that it lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Vulpix
description: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out its desires. Those who eat it fall under Pecharunt's control.
